scope: Raw CEL normalization, fixed gene mapping, coverage and descriptive assay QC. No program score or treatment/donor contrast.
source_namespace_clarification: Four ETS2/CHR21 sets use Ensembl genes; four GOBP comparators use exact case-sensitive HGNC symbols resolved uniquely to Ensembl in the complete release116 crosswalk, then the same reciprocal one-to-one Ensembl-Entrez rule. No aliases or array-symbol fallback.
crosswalk_release: Ensembl116 June2026 complete human BioMart export, separate wholehuman gene-count query; final query/source hashes must be pinned before mapping

array_qc.raw_probe_definition: CDF-defined perfect-match entries passed to RMA
array_qc.normalized_matrix: 54675 unique probe sets x30 unique GSM columns, finite log2 RMA
array_qc.rle: full-probe log2 RMA minus per-probe median acrossall30arrays; median and IQR perarray
array_qc.pca_if_generated: all probes, centered perprobe, no variance scaling or highvariance selection; descriptive only
